GameInfo
{
	AddEventHandlers = "RomtgHandler"
	PlayerClasses = "RomtgPlayer"
}

// Only our map: Doom's own episodes and levels are gone. The launcher starts it directly with
// `+map ROMTG -skill 3`, so the title screen and the new game / difficulty menus never show.
// The map itself (one flat, empty square) is generated by scripts/flatmap.py at build time.
ClearEpisodes

Episode ROMTG
{
	Name = "Realm of the Mad God"
	NoSkillMenu
}

Map ROMTG "Realm of the Mad God"
{
	Next = "ROMTG"
	// No sky shows (the ceiling is a plain one, coloured with the ground round you: see
	// scripts/flatmap.py); kept black in case. RTBLACK is generated by build-mod.
	Sky1 = "RTBLACK"
	NoIntermission
	NoAutosaveHint
}
